description: This file contains internal utility functions and classes for testing and scripting in PyTorch, including functions for creating scripted modules, tracing, and handling tensor inputs, specifically used within the internal testing framework for JIT and neural network modules.

classes.name: dont_convert
classes.description: A tuple subclass with no additional slots, used as a marker or placeholder in tensor creation functions.

classes.name: non_differentiable
classes.description: A namedtuple with a 'tensor' field, used to mark tensors as non-differentiable in test inputs.

classes.name: SplitInputs
classes.description: A class that splits function inputs into tensor and non-tensor parts, used for tracing and scripting in tests.

methods.name: unpack_variables
methods.description: Recursively unpacks nested tuples of variables.

methods.name: create_input
methods.description: Creates tensor inputs with specified properties for testing, handling various input types and options.

methods.name: get_nn_functional_tests
methods.description: Returns a list of test configurations for various neural network functional interfaces.

methods.name: gen_script_fn_and_args
methods.description: Generates a scripted function and example inputs from method name and arguments.

methods.name: create_script_fn
methods.description: Creates a scripted function that runs a compiled TorchScript from method name and type.

methods.name: create_traced_fn
methods.description: Creates a traced version of a function for testing, with optional caching.

methods.name: get_nn_functional_compiled_fn_and_inputs
methods.description: Generates a compiled functional test and inputs for a given neural network functional method.

methods.name: create_script_module
methods.description: Creates a scripted module from a PyTorch nn.Module, with support for defining submodules and testing export/import.

methods.name: check_alias_annotation
methods.description: Checks aliasing annotations in a scripted function's graph for correctness.

methods.name: get_nn_module_name_from_kwargs
methods.description: Extracts the module name from keyword arguments.

methods.name: get_nn_mod_test_name
methods.description: Constructs a test name for a neural network module based on kwargs.

methods.name: get_nn_module_class_from_kwargs
methods.description: Derives the class name of a module from kwargs.

methods.name: try_get_nn_module_compiled_mod_and_inputs
methods.description: Attempts to create a compiled module and inputs for testing, with filtering for unsupported or excluded modules.

methods.name: get_all_nn_module_tests
methods.description: Returns a list of additional neural network module test configurations.
